name: WinnerAdSpy
summary: An ad-spy subscription with one official Pro plan at €7 a month or €56 a year.
description: WinnerAdSpy (Winneradspy) is an ad-spy product with unlimited ad-spy access on its Pro plan. Official pricing and FAQ: Pro is €7 per month, billed monthly, cancel anytime, no contract. A yearly plan is €56 per year (33% less than month-to-month, stated as €4.67/month billed yearly). Access lasts until the end of the period you paid for, and future updates are included on the yearly plan. No other public paid tier was listed on the official pricing page checked.
